'''??Foroguemon??''' is a secret piece of [[furniture]] obtained by placing a [[Strange Bun]] in the toy chest in [[Vincent]]'s room of [[1 Willow Lane]]. Once placed, it can be moved by holding left-click, or by using a [[Tools|tool]].

==History==
{{History|1.0|Introduced.}}
{{History|1.4|Fixed bug where an entire stack of Strange Buns would be consumed when interacting with the toy chest.  Added Korean display name to data files.}}
